one_sentence_supported_claim: On one fixed native DINO CEM development root, an execution-equivalent forecast-request canonicalization lowers cumulative dense return while improving several success endpoints and average fixed-action prefix feature accuracy; trusted-current-candidate binding exactly restores the original trajectory.

native_return_effect.secondary_success_metrics: Descriptive, not advance criteria. Report first success and successful control counts alongside return; lower return is not necessarily worse goal attainment.
native_return_effect.decision: A separately frozen causal recovery pilot is justified; no paper/generalization claim.
native_return_effect.prediction_accuracy: Not measured on this native run. Different visited trajectories must not be compared as a paired forecast-error effect.
native_return_effect.historical_trigger_scope: The decision and prediction_accuracy text inside this original trigger object describe the state before the separately registered recovery/forecast follow-ups. Completed current results are in recovery, forecast_diagnostic and utility_timing_decomposition.

recovery.decision: Registered cumulative return recovered on this root.
recovery.interpretation: Conventional trusted-current-candidate restoration; source trace exactness is not an acceptance criterion. Success metrics and terminal distance remain separate endpoints.

clean_identity_copy.scope: Descriptive paired representation differences along this origin's selected actions; correlated observations, no between-trajectory causal subtraction.

canonical_request.scope: Descriptive paired representation differences along this origin's selected actions; correlated observations, no between-trajectory causal subtraction.

forecast_diagnostic.scope: 14 final-mean queries,38 real executed-prefix endpoints from one root pair. Both representations compared on identical state/actions/truth within each query. Descriptive correlated observations, no independent-sample test. Native full CEM candidate-ranking mediation unmeasured.

go_no_go.bounded_conditional_representation_effec: GO: observed and reproducibly archived on this root.
go_no_go.goal_swap_native_security_harm: NO-GO: this experiment does not change a forecast Goal; Goal enters only the DINO objective.
go_no_go.harm_uniquely_from_worsened_prediction: NO-GO: matched query1 full30-control forecasts improve for both means, and actual-future native scoring still selects the lower-reward candidate. This proves proxy/utility mismatch on this bank, not absence of forecast-error mediation or a full99-step explanation.
go_no_go.large_scale_security_expansion_or_paper_: NO-GO with current evidence: no qualified general new security mechanism, independent generalization or novel defense. A researcher-defined writer remains valid for this bounded experiment; absence of a deployed writer does not erase the result.

statistics.reason: One physical root. A post-hoc two-mean bank shows one ranking reversal; it is not a population flip rate or a reconstruction of the native full candidate set.

next_decisive_work: Close the forecast-degradation explanation for this measured bank, retain its conditional decision effect, and return to mechanism discovery. Do not rerun this bank, expand native alias seeds, restart NanoWM or generate the closed Cosmos bank without a new decision-relevant hypothesis.
preserved_failures: CPU calibration attempt remains invalid; GPU protocol was separately registered with unchanged samples/tolerances before any counterfactual outputs.
Earlier fixed+2 operation remains no-harm; canonicalization was not retrospectively relabeled as that old successful attack.

utility_timing_decomposition.scope: Post hoc arithmetic on one fixed reach-v3/reward-v2 native pair; no new trajectories or forecast calls.
utility_timing_decomposition.decision: Unequal episode exposure and reduced successful occupancy do not explain the dense-return loss. Preserve real integrated-return harm and improved success endpoints; timing decomposition is not candidate-ranking or prediction-error mediation.

first_query_fixed_two_mean_ranking.scope: One shared initial context, original goal and two post-hoc selected full native returned means. Fixed native terminal objective on cached forecasts; real utility from each existing15-control prefix. Not the complete CEM bank or a new trajectory experiment.

first_query_full_horizon_truth.limits: Fixed two-mean open-loop bank on one known root; native executes15 then replans. Not full CEM-population mediation, success-rate loss, Goal-Swap, independent generalization or training-support proof. Error direction may still mediate selection; no claim that all forecast-error effects are excluded.
first_query_full_horizon_truth.decision: Retain local representation-to-selection effect and measured physical loss; reject prediction-degradation attribution on this bank. Do not expand this construct without a distinct mechanism.
